ConnectionStrings._Redis: Read-through cache in front of SQL (tenant settings, agent linkage, dashboard aggregates, usage counters). Leave empty and the same cache runs in process — correct, just not shared between instances, so set it for anything running more than one. Example: localhost:6379,abortConnect=false. Keep abortConnect=false: it lets the app start and keep serving while Redis is down, which is what the cache code already assumes.

Jwt._Secret: NEVER commit the signing key. Set JWT__SECRET (env) or Jwt:Secret in appsettings.Local.json. The API refuses to start without a real one.

Encryption._: Application-layer encryption of JSON request/response bodies for the web app, on top of TLS. Retell webhooks and live-call tools, the platform endpoints, /health and Swagger are exempt by path and always speak plain JSON.
Encryption._Required: When true, non-exempt endpoints reject requests that arrive without an encrypted session. Leave false to keep Swagger and curl usable against a running API.

Platform._AdminKey: NEVER commit this. Shared secret the super admin console (AiReceptionist.SuperAdmin) presents in X-Platform-Key on /api/v1/platform/*. Set the same random value (32+ chars) here via appsettings.Local.json / PLATFORM__ADMINKEY and in the console. Without it the platform endpoints return 503.

Retell._ApiKey: NEVER commit the API key. Managed centrally in the database (SuperAdmin → Retell connection); appsettings.Local.json / Retell__ApiKey seed it on first run.
Retell._DefaultVoiceId: The voice a tenant starts on. Must be one of the platform voices in Shared/RetellVoices.cs — retell-Grace, retell-Ashley, retell-Chloe or retell-Nico — because expressive mode is only honoured for those. Anything else is ignored in favour of retell-Grace.
Retell._CallSyncMinutes: How often finished calls are pulled from Retell for every connected tenant. The webhook is still the fast path; this is the net under it, so a delivery that never arrived does not leave a call — and its minutes — missing until somebody presses Sync.

Stripe._SecretKey: NEVER commit the secret key. Set STRIPE__SECRETKEY (env) or Stripe:SecretKey in appsettings.Local.json. Without it billing screens still work, but nothing is collected automatically — payments have to be recorded by hand in the super admin console.
Stripe._WebhookSecret: NEVER commit this either. The signing secret Stripe shows when you add the endpoint (whsec_...). Without it every webhook delivery is rejected, so invoices and payments are never mirrored back.
Stripe._AppBaseUrl: Where Stripe returns the customer after Checkout or the billing portal. Defaults to the first Cors:AllowedOrigins entry.

Billing._: How often elapsed billing periods are totalled into OrganizationUsagePeriods. Stripe's invoice.created webhook also triggers a close, so this is the safety net rather than the main path.
Billing._Reconcile: Re-reads what Stripe says it has collected and records anything the webhook never delivered. Leave this on: a rotated signing secret or an endpoint that was down past Stripe's ~3-day retry window otherwise leaves a paid customer looking unpaid, and the overdue sweep eventually suspends them for it. Every recovery is logged as a warning, because it means the webhook itself needs attention.
Billing._ReconcileLookbackDays: How far back each pass looks. Wider than Stripe's own retry window so an outage that outlasted every redelivery is still caught.

Osm._: Free OpenStreetMap services used to check a caller's address against the coverage areas set in Settings -> Business -> Locations. No key and no account: Nominatim geocodes the address, Overpass names landmarks near it. Both are called from the server only, at most once a second, and cached. A tenant with no coverage areas never touches either.
Osm._Contact: An email or URL put in the User-Agent, which Nominatim's usage policy asks for so they can reach the operator of a busy client instead of just blocking it. Set it before any real traffic.
Osm._LandmarkRadiusMeters: How far counts as walking distance when looking for something to name near an address.

_Push: Browser notifications (Web Push). Generate a key pair with: dotnet run --project backend/AiReceptionist.Api -- vapid, then put it in appsettings.Local.json. Costs nothing to send; leave empty to turn notifications off.
